what_to_detect: An as-enters (or as-turned-face-up) replacement updates a permanent's move to the battlefield and the ability it runs sets the permanent's power and toughness to one of the listed values.
near_miss: A zone change to the battlefield that met such a replacement and was not updated (the card did not enter, or the replacement did not apply).
record_fields: rewrite payload incoming (zone_change to battlefield), result, replaced_by
sidecar script of the replaced_by line (SetPower$/SetToughness$)

what_to_detect: An effect that modifies or sets power and/or toughness is applied to a permanent that is not a creature: its P/T contribution is recorded against a noncreature entity, and takes effect only once that permanent becomes a creature.
near_miss: The effect applies to a noncreature permanent and contributes no P/T change.
record_fields: snapshot entity types (creature absent) and pt (null on a noncreature)

what_to_detect: A resolution whose effect quantity (cards drawn, damage, life, counters) equals the source creature's base power or toughness as the snapshot shows it, where base and modified values differ because of boosts or counters.
near_miss: A resolution of a base-power-reading ability where the quantity would equal the modified power instead (boosts or counters counted).
record_fields: effect half event amounts (card_drawn count, damage_dealt amount, life_change delta, counter_change delta)
snapshot entity pt.base, pt.boosts, pt.counters (gen-3 base_pt, pt_boosts)
